description: Land Acquisition - Siyambalakote, Ambalantota D/S Division, Hambantota District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes. It contains detailed descriptions of land lots, their locations, extents, and claimants, which falls squarely under the "Land and property-related matters" category defined for Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
